reels.title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
reels.summary:
Wall Street hammered Alphabet for an earnings miss that included weaker-than-expected revenue in the company’s core business.

Revenue in the search and other segment grew 12% from a year ago to roughly $63 billion, but came in below estimates for the second straight quarter.

CNBC's MacKenzie Sigalos has the latest.

reels.title: It's a 'socialist' bank — and North Dakota Republicans love it
reels.summary:
The Bank of North Dakota is the country’s only state-owned bank. It enjoys broad support from the red state’s current political leaders and serves as an example for progressives aiming to reignite public banking.

CNBC's Garrett Downs traveled to North Dakota to learn how the bank operates.

reels.title: Affordability in caregiving matters to midterm voters, survey finds
reels.summary:
An AARP survey of competitive congressional districts found 77% of likely voters age 50 and older said they would be more likely to vote for a candidate who advocated for a tax credit for unpaid family caregivers.

CNBC's Sharon Epperson has the details.
